news.title: Dealer sold fentanyl laced pills that killed 2 metro Atlanta high school students
news.summary: A Gwinnett County man has pleaded guilty in connection with the fentanyl overdose deaths of two Norcross teenagers.

news.title: 3 injured after MARTA bus driver falls asleep behind the wheel
news.summary: A MARTA bus driver faces charges after falling asleep behind the wheel, crossing traffic lanes and crashing into a tree Sept. 7 in Dunwoody.

news.title: Video shows MARTA driver nodding off with hands in his lap before bus crashes
news.summary: Dunwoody police say a MARTA driver was charged after a bus crash on Labor Day on North Shallowford Road that hurt the driver and 2 passengers.

news.title: Norfolk Southern contractor dies after shooting near railway property in Austell, officials say
news.summary: The incident happened just outside the Norfolk Southern property located at 6000 Dr. Luke Glenn Jr. Memorial Highway.

news.title: Man killed in shooting at Austell Norfolk Southern facility identified
news.summary: A man who witnesses said had just arrived for work was shot and killed Monday night in the employee parking lot of a Norfolk Southern intermodal facility in Austell.

news.title: Body found on roof of soul food restaurant in Atlanta
news.summary: A death investigation is underway after a body was found on the roof of a restaurant in Atlanta.

news.title: Lawrenceville man sentenced for fentanyl pills that killed 2 teens
news.summary: A 24-year-old man will spend 35 years in prison for supplying fentanyl-laced pills that caused the fatal overdoses of two Norcross teenagers.

news.title: 22-year-old caregiver arrested after 3-year-old found wandering in Marietta, police say
news.summary: Warrants indicate that she did not realize the child was missing for about 30 minutes.

news.title: Georgia death row inmate has clemency hearing today, with other legal challenges ongoing before execution scheduled for tomorrow
news.summary: It's unclear how likely any path would give a reprieve to Stacey Humphreys, who was convicted of killing two women in Cobb County in 2003.

news.title: Caregiver arrested after 3-year-old found alone in Marietta
news.summary: Police arrested a 22-year-old caregiver Monday night after a 3-year-old boy was found wandering alone near a busy intersection, according to police.

news.title: Woman wanted for alleged road-rage shooting in Gwinnett County, police say
news.summary: Gwinnett County police seek Sierra Iman Little, 23, accused of aggravated assault and firing shots in a road-rage incident.

news.title: 11Alive helps with arrest of man allegedly stealing HVAC units in DeKalb County
news.summary: According to DeKalb County arrest warrants, Christian Ikechukwu Oji, was caught on video stealing HVAC units from a woman's home on two separate occasions.
